nws_alerts.headline: Beach Hazards Statement issued November 19 at 1:33AM PST until November 20 at 9:00AM PST by NWS San Diego CA
nws_alerts.description:
* WHAT...Surf of 3 to 5 feet. Sets to 7 feet along west-facing
beaches.

* WHERE...San Diego County Coastal Areas and Orange County
Coastal Areas.

* WHEN...From 6 AM PST today through Friday morning.

* IMPACTS...Increased risk for rip currents. Areas of coastal
flooding possible during high tide each morning along
boardwalks and parking lots.

wave_rule: higher of the two models, per stretch and hour (since 2026-11-14)

notes.heights: feet above MLLW (an ordinary low tide), NOAA La Jolla datums
notes.berm: when the bay-side berm is up (docs/evidence/berm_status.csv, else Oct-Apr) the headline assumes it holds (assumed top 9.0 ft); at 7.8 ft or more it may leak (at least Moderate)
